title: Prove omega_n -> 0 as n -> infinity for n-ball volume

problemStatement.plain: COMPLETED: omega_tendsto_zero proved. Even formula ω(2k)=π^k/k!, odd bound ω(2k+1)≤2·ω(2k), squeeze via summable_pow_div_factorial. 0 sorries, 0 axioms.

builtItems: omega_even_formula: ω(2k) = π^k/k! proved by induction (AreaOfCircleOQ01OQ02OQ01OQ01OQ01.lean:37-47)
insights: ω(2k) = π^k/k! exactly — these are the terms of e^π, hence → 0 from summability
Odd bound: 4π/(2k+3) ≤ 4π/(2k+2) since 2k+3 ≥ 2k+2 — the induction step is pure arithmetic
Universal bound ω(n) ≤ 2·π^(n/2)/(n/2)! avoids needing to combine even/odd limit arguments
Key Mathlib lemma: summable_pow_div_factorial gives tendsto directly from Summable.tendsto_atTop_zero
